route.instructions: Select exactly one route by the user's intended task. Route requests by meaning, including plausible future phone capabilities. Use phone_health_check for overall phone condition or requests spanning multiple live-data categories. Use answer for ordinary responses or when no stable tool intent can be inferred.

criteria.answer: General knowledge, arithmetic, writing, conversation, or a request requiring clarification because no stable tool intent is clear.
criteria.get_device_info: Identify this device or inspect its OS, hardware specifications, capabilities, ratings, or certifications.
criteria.get_battery_info: Inspect this phone's battery level, charging, temperature, health, usage, or runtime estimates.
criteria.get_storage_info: Inspect this phone's storage space, usage, capacity, or internal or external storage status.
criteria.get_media_info: Inspect current or recent media playback, metadata, availability, or playback settings.
criteria.search_local_files: Find files on this device by name, type, content, time, location, or provenance.
criteria.search_notes: Retrieve information or a note previously saved in the notes system.
criteria.save_note: Store new information in the notes system when the user explicitly asks to save or remember it.
criteria.phone_health_check: Inspect the phone's overall condition or readiness, or combine two or more live phone-data categories.
